content: The features used to build attribute vectors for training our classification model are described below. We use character level and word level features for the classification BIBREF15 . For all the features, we separated the words in the tweets based on the language annotation (Section 2.3) and prepared the feature vector for each tweet by combining the vectors for both the languages .
